scene: Kitchen table on a weekday morning. Mom sits at screen-left; Child stands beside the table at screen-right. One rainbow drawing lies flat on the table and appears only when mentioned. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child asks with light, patient interest and shows one small proud smile about his drawing; Mom answers warmly.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Mom sits at the table with hands folded; Child stands beside the table with empty hands; the tabletop is clear.
clips.action: Mom shares the Saturday news. Child rests one hand on the table edge and asks who is coming with Grandma.
clips.end: Mom sits with hands folded; Child rests one hand on the table edge; the tabletop stays clear.

clips.start: Mom sits with hands folded; Child rests one hand on the table edge; the tabletop stays clear.
clips.action: Mom draws a small clock circle in the air with one finger while giving the train time. Child asks what he should show Grandma; Mom slides the rainbow drawing into view and lays it flat at center.
clips.end: The rainbow drawing lies flat at table center; Mom's hand rests beside it; Child looks down at it.

clips.start: The rainbow drawing lies flat at table center; both look down at it.
clips.action: Child points at the rainbow drawing, then asks about pancakes while miming one small flip with his hand. Mom nods and gives a small thumbs-up.
clips.end: Child's hand rests on the drawing; Mom's thumbs-up relaxes to the table; both smile gently.
